content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 14.1 (Assignment) is mutual and already permits assignment on a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all related assets without consent, and no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right exists (Section 11 triggers are only uncured material breach and insolvency) — so the clause avoids walk-away territory. It nonetheless falls short of the fallback because consent for all other assignments is at each party's unfettered discretion, and there is no affiliate/intra-group carve-out for us.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** added "which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed" and an affiliate carve-out ("any entity controlling, controlled by or under common control with such party"), leaving the M&A carve-out and the mutual direct-competitor exception untouched.
